description_en: You can invoke SignInGroup to sign an agent into a specified skill group under a specified instance, which is the operation for publishing the agent online
description_zh: 调用SignInGroup使坐席签入指定实例下的指定技能组，即坐席上线操作
kebab_example: aliyun ccc sign-in-group --instance-id ccc-test --user-id agent@ccc-test --device-id CCC-xx.xx.xx.xx-chrome119-bse1b618bff3xxxxd --signed-skill-group-id-list '["skillgroup1@ccc-test","skillgroup2@ccc-test"]' --chat-device-id 4c51c9116c36537cb850dc1081d745df --additivity false --api-version 2020-07-01 --region cn-hangzhou
name: SignInGroup

parameters.help_en: Agent ID. If not specified, the agent mapped to the current Resource Access Management (RAM) user is used by default
parameters.help_zh: 坐席ID，不填默认使用当前RAM账号映射的坐席
parameters.name: user_id

parameters.help_en: Voice device ID. When multiple voice devices are active, use this parameter to specify one of them, such as a browser Web Real-Time Communication (WebRTC) endpoint or a SIP phone
parameters.help_zh: 语音设备ID。当有多个语音设备可用时，通过此参数指定其中一个语音设备，比如浏览器WebRTC或者SIP话机等
parameters.name: device_id

parameters.help_en: List of skill group IDs to sign in to, formatted as a JSON array string, where each array element is a skill group ID
parameters.help_zh: 想要签入的技能组ID列表，格式为JSON数组字符串，数组元素是技能组ID
parameters.name: signed_skill_group_id_list

parameters.help_en: If an agent has already signed in to some skill groups, setting this parameter to true allows the agent to sign in to additional skill groups
parameters.help_zh: 座席已经签入一些技能组后，如果指定此参数为True, 则可以签入更多新技能组
parameters.name: additivity
